items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: About 12 o'clock here comes Beryl Bryden to take me to a party.

ctx.x: So when I got back to London I was just a bundle of nerves, you know. Nothing but nerves and I got in like, like on a Sunday morning and I wanted so bad to go to sleep but I was too nervous to sleep. My nerves were just all shot. And I got
to bed about 10 o'clock. About 12 o'clock here comes Beryl Bryden to take me to a party.
